subject: organic
question:
有机化学·区域选择性（Reactivity Learn 改编）：底物 Pyridine，试剂及条件 NaNH₂, then H₂O (Chichibabin)。Where does the amide ion attack?（请选择通常的主要反应位点。）
A. C3
B. C2
C. C4
explanation: 来源英文解析（待专业审校）：Nucleophiles add at C2 or C4, where the negative charge of the adduct can sit on nitrogen; the amide ion goes to C2.
